mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair oxycodone metabolism and increase CNS depression risk, while oxycodone may mask symptoms of amphotericin B toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and CNS status closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust oxycodone dosing based on renal function and clinical response.
